trigger: The preregistration already required negative controls; this amendment makes their exact TRAIN/DEV-only implementation explicit before Stage 3 is run.

controls.own_recent_price: DEV Spearman of price_change_30 with each target
controls.current_absolute_movement: DEV Spearman of absolute_return_30 with each target
controls.recent_activity_future: DEV Spearman of trade_count_30 with each target
controls.activity_contemporaneous: DEV association of trade_count_30 with absolute_return_30
controls.circular_shift: For the frozen top candidate feature, rotate finite values within each market by half the available observations after timestamp sorting, leaving missing-value positions unchanged; report DEV Spearman to the target.

selection_use: NONE. Negative-control results cannot alter shortlist membership, candidate labels, model features or DEV-selected hyperparameters.
